_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE -- not calibration output, and not a bundle any
integrator should copy. Every number and every magnitude string here is
invented to exercise the loader, and each one is chosen to be impossible
[0, 1] can ever reach it, so a VIOLATED verdict under --foreground can
only come from the loader reading the foreground column. That is the
point: it isolates the column choice from the measurement.
* changed_area_fraction.threshold_foreground is null, which is how a
bundle says 'no separate foreground figure was derived'. The loader
must fall back to the full-frame threshold rather than to zero.
* every detection-limit string is prefixed SYNTHETIC and every
perturbation name synthetic_, so a limit leaking into a report is
The real bundle is generated by the integrator from
scripts/detection_limits.json; the schema is documented at the top of

metrics._comment: keys beginning with _ are comments and must be skipped
